Parameters of Types of Levels, and Members of No Type of Levels

no_level_members Θ Ξ Γ E: the module expression E, read in Γ, denotes a description with no member of a type of levels (wf_no_level_members).
Definition no_level_members (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) (E : modexp) : Prop :=
  exists R, mdenote Θ Ξ Γ E R /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ R.

levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δ E: what E denotes under the parameters Δ can be abstracted over them (mdesc_up): every parameter is a type of levels, or no member of E has a type of levels. A member of type A abstracted over Δ is of Π Δ. A, which is no type when A is a type of levels and a parameter is a type of a universe (wf_pi_level). The alias, flatten and body rules ask it of their targets and bodies (the premise with the flag lv), local ones over their parameters and filed ones over their full telescopes. Where M has def v : Level ≔ 0l:
  • module A (n : ℕ) ≔ M is rejected;
  • module A (u : Level) ≔ M is accepted;
  • module L (B : Type) ≔ List B is accepted: List has no member of a type of levels;
  • module N (n : ℕ) where module A ≔ M end is rejected: the filed alias is read over N's parameter;
  • module N (n : ℕ) where module K (u : Level) where def w : Level ≔ u end end is rejected: w is read over n and u.
Definition levels_abstractable (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (E : modexp) : Prop :=
  level_sorted_parameters Δ \/ no_level_members Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E.

The flag premise of the alias, flatten and body rules over the parameters Δ of a target E, as one record: the form the structural lemmas move it in.
Record levels_flag (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (E : modexp) (lv : bool) (Rt : mdesc) : Prop := mk_levels_flag
  {
With the flag set, every parameter is a type of levels
    levels_flag_sorted : lv = true -> level_sorted_parameters Δ
    
Without it, Rt is what the target denotes
  ; levels_flag_denotes : lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E Rt
    
and it has no member of a type of levels
  ; levels_flag_no_level : lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt }.

The flag premise of the rules is levels_abstractable.
Lemma levels_abstractable_of_flag : forall Θ Ξ Γ Δ E (lv : bool) Rt,
    (lv = true -> level_sorted_parameters Δ) ->
    (lv = false -> mdenote Θ Ξ (Δ ++ Γ) E Rt) ->
    (lv = false -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ ++ Γ ⊢ⁿˡ Rt) ->
    levels_abstractable Θ Ξ Γ Δ E.
Proof.
  intros * Ht Hm Hn; destruct lv; [ left; exact (Ht eq_refl) | right; exists Rt; split; [ exact (Hm eq_refl) | exact (Hn eq_refl) ] ].
Qed.

Units

A unit filed at a level, or a frame of the stack, is a body checked by ⊢ᵍᵐ: ⊢ᵍᵘ is not a judgment of its own, but this definition, which the block states inline (wf_gstack_cons). Two further projections are presuppositions, in Presup: ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gu_params U of ⊢ᵍᵐ, hence of ⊢ᵍᵘ, and ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil of ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ.

#[warnings="-cannot-define-projection"]
Record wf_gunit (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (mp : qname) (K : frame_kind) (U : gunit) : Prop := mk_wf_gunit
  {
The unit's parameters
    wf_gunit_params : ctx
    
The unit's body
  ; wf_gunit_body : gmod
    
The unit is a body module
  ; wf_gunit_eq : U = gu_body wf_gunit_params wf_gunit_body
    
Its body is a module of kind K
  ; wf_gunit_wf : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ wf_gunit_params ⊢ᵍᵐ wf_gunit_body }.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U" := (wf_gunit Θ Ξ mp K U) : type_scope.

Lemma wf_gunit_intro : forall Θ Ξ mp K Δ Φ, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ Δ ⊢ᵍᵐ Φ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ gu_body Δ Φ.
Proof. intros; econstructor; [ reflexivity | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_gunit_mod : forall Θ Ξ mp K U, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⍮ gu_params U ⊢ᵍᵐ gu_mod U.
Proof. intros * [Δ Φ -> H]; exact H. Qed.

The unit form of the two constructors that file one.

Lemma wf_gstack_cons' : forall Θ Ξ mp K U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mp, K, U) :: Ξ.
Proof. intros * ? [Δ Φ -> ?] ?; apply wf_gstack_cons; assumption. Qed.

Lemma wf_gstack_cons_inv : forall Θ Ξ mp K U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ (mp, K, U) :: Ξ -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ Ξ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⍮ K ⊢ᵍᵘ U /\ frame_fresh Θ Ξ mp.
Proof. inversion 1; subst; eauto using wf_gunit_intro. Qed.

Filing, from the premises of the frame it closes.
Lemma wf_gstack_file' : forall Θ fp U,
    ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil -> Θ ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⍮ fk_module ⊢ᵍᵘ U -> gds_lookup Θ fp = None -> ⊢ᵍ (fp, U) :: Θ ⍮ nil.
Proof. intros * ? ? ?; apply wf_gstack_file, wf_gstack_cons'; [ assumption | assumption | split; [ assumption | reflexivity ] ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_gstack_file_inv : forall Θ fp U,
    ⊢ᵍ (fp, U) :: Θ ⍮ nil -> ⊢ᵍ Θ ⍮ nil /\ Θ ⍮ nil ⍮ q_abs fp nil ⍮ fk_module ⊢ᵍᵘ U /\ gds_lookup Θ fp = None.
Proof.
  inversion 1; subst.
  match goal with H : ⊢ᵍ _ ⍮ _ :: nil |- _ => destruct (wf_gstack_cons_inv _ _ _ _ _ H) as (? & ? & [? _]) end; auto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_ctx wf_exp wf_exp_eq wf_subtyp wf_is_univ ctx_lookup ctx_lookup_def : mctt.

Types of Either Sort

Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A: A is a type, of a large universe, a proposition or a type of levels, or it is the sort LevelSort itself, which is of no sort: levels are closed under Level@n and the Πs between types of levels only, so no variable, family or ex falso is at LevelSort. It is the type of every term's type (presup_exp_typ): Level@n : LevelSort. (A trailing word type would make type a keyword, which breaks every %type scope delimiter.) It is outside the mutual block, so no mutual induction has a motive for it; the rules state its parts as premises, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Srt and type_sort Srt.
Inductive wf_type (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ : ctx) : typ -> Prop :=
A type of a sort: a large universe, Prop or LevelSort
| wf_type_of_sort : forall A S, type_sort S -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : S -> wf_type Θ Ξ Γ A
The sort of the types of levels, in a well-formed context
| wf_type_level_sort : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> wf_type Θ Ξ Γ LevelSort.
Arguments wf_type_of_sort {Θ Ξ Γ A}.
Arguments wf_type_level_sort {Θ Ξ Γ}.

Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A" := (wf_type Θ Ξ Γ A) (at level 70, Ξ at level 69, Γ at level 69, A at level 69) : type_scope.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_type : mctt.

A type of a large universe is a type.
Lemma wf_type_univ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A i}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (wf_type_of_sort _ (type_sort_universe i) H). Qed.

So is a proposition.
Lemma wf_type_prop : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Propₘ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (wf_type_of_sort _ type_sort_prop H). Qed.

So is a term of the sort at a kind.
Lemma wf_type_kind : forall {Θ Ξ Γ r A i}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (wf_type_of_sort _ (type_sort_abs_kind r _ (type_sort_universe i)) H). Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_type_univ wf_type_prop : mctt.

Make the sorts of a rule concrete: a type sort is a large universe, Prop or LevelSort, a sort of a kind is the kind's, a relevant sort is a large universe or LevelSort, the kinds of a Π are one of the three pairs, and a kind is one of the three, so that abs_kind_sort computes.
Ltac destruct_type_sort :=
  repeat match goal with
         | H : type_sort _ |- _ => destruct H
         | H : sort_kind _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : evaluated_sort _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : pi_kinds _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : level_closed_sort _ _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : module_body_sort _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : motive_kind _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | H : evaluated_kind _ |- _ => inversion H; subst; clear H
         | r : abs_kind |- _ => destruct r
         end;
  cbn [abs_kind_sort] in *.

A parameter's sort is closed: no operation moves it.
Lemma parameter_sort_sub : forall l S σ, parameter_sort l S -> S[σ] = S.
Proof. intros * []; reflexivity. Qed.

Lemma parameter_sort_wk : forall l S φ, parameter_sort l S -> S[φ]ʷ = S.
Proof. intros * []; reflexivity. Qed.

A parameter's sort is a type sort.
Lemma parameter_sort_type_sort : forall l S, parameter_sort l S -> type_sort S.
Proof. intros * []; constructor. Qed.

An evaluated sort is a type sort.
Lemma evaluated_sort_type_sort : forall S, evaluated_sort S -> type_sort S.
Proof. intros S []; constructor. Qed.

The result sort of a former that keeps levels closed is a type sort.
Lemma level_closed_sort_type_sort : forall Sc S, level_closed_sort Sc S -> type_sort S.
Proof. intros * []; constructor. Qed.

The sort of a motive, a universe or Prop, is built from components of any sort.
Lemma level_closed_motive_kind : forall Sc r i, motive_kind r -> level_closed_sort Sc (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i).
Proof. intros Sc r i []; constructor. Qed.

A local module may be at it.
Lemma module_body_motive_kind : forall r i, motive_kind r -> module_body_sort (abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i).
Proof. intros r i []; constructor. Qed.

The sort a local module's body is at is a type sort.
Lemma module_body_sort_type_sort : forall S, module_body_sort S -> type_sort S.
Proof. intros * []; constructor. Qed.

A type of levels is a type.
Lemma wf_type_level : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : LevelSort -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ A.
Proof. intros * H; exact (wf_type_of_sort _ type_sort_level H). Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve evaluated_sort_type_sort level_closed_sort_type_sort
  level_closed_motive_kind module_body_motive_kind module_body_sort_type_sort parameter_sort_type_sort wf_type_level : mctt.

#[export]
Hint Constructors type_sort sort_kind evaluated_sort pi_kinds motive_kind carg_kind field_kind evaluated_kind
  level_closed_sort module_body_sort parameter_sort : mctt.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_ext_eq wf_unit_eq wf_modexp_eq : mctt.

The two instances of wf_gentry_def, with a body and without (an axiom), whose conclusions name the entry as it is filed.
Lemma wf_gentry_def_body : forall Θ Ξ mp b pv r A M i, r <> ak_level ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) (Some (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) M)).
Proof.
  intros * Hr HA HM; change (Some (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ) M)) with (option_map (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ)) (Some M)).
  eapply wf_gentry_def; [ exact HA | intros E; contradiction | intros ? [= <-]; exact HM | discriminate ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_gentry_def_axiom : forall Θ Ξ mp b pv r A i, r <> ak_level ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ gs_tele Ξ ⊢ A : abs_kind_sort r Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ mp ⊢ᵉ ge_def b pv r (ctx_pi_at r (gs_tele Ξ) A) None.
Proof.
  intros * Hr HA; change (@None exp) with (option_map (ctx_fn (gs_tele Ξ)) None).
  eapply wf_gentry_def; [ exact HA | intros E; contradiction | discriminate | intros _; exact Hr ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Constructors wf_gentry wf_gmod wf_gstack : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_gentry_def_body wf_gentry_def_axiom : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_gunit_intro : mctt.

Weakening and Substitution Typing

These are the derived judgments. They are records, not inductive relations: a weakening or a substitution is well-typed exactly when it sends each binding of its source context to something of the correspondingly transported type in its target. Nothing here is recursive, so none of it belongs in the mutual block above; the price is that closure under the operations (Id, _,,_, q, _⨟_) has to be proved, which is what wf_wk_id–wf_wk_compose and wf_sub_id–wf_sub_q do.

Record wf_wk (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (φ : wk) : Prop := wf_wk_intro
{ wf_wk_dom : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ
; wf_wk_cod : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ
; wf_wk_lookup : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) : A[φ]ʷ
A renaming sends a definition to the same definition.
; wf_wk_lookup_def : forall x A M, Δ ∋ #x ≔ M : A -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) ≔ M[φ]ʷ : A[φ]ʷ
A renaming sends a module slot to a slot of the same unit.
; wf_wk_lookup_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> Γ ∋ #(φ x) ≔ₘ gunit_wk U φ
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ φ : Δ" := (wf_wk Θ Ξ Γ Δ φ) : type_scope.

Record wf_sub (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ : sub) : Prop := wf_sub_intro
{ wf_sub_dom : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ
; wf_sub_cod : ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Δ
; wf_sub_apply : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] : A[σ]
A substitution sends a definition to something equal to its body.
; wf_sub_apply_def : forall x A M, Δ ∋ #x ≔ M : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ M[σ] : A[σ]
A substitution sends a module slot to the unit it holds, transported: as a well-formed literal (the module part of an se_mod or an se_dm), or as a slot holding that unit.
; wf_sub_apply_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U ->
    (sentry_modexp (σ x) = me_lit U[σ]ᵘ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U[σ]ᵘ ≈ U[σ]ᵘ) \/ exists y, σ x = se_var y /\ Γ ∋ #y ≔ₘ U[σ]ᵘ
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ" := (wf_sub Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ) : type_scope.

The type at which the images are equated is A[σ]; it could equally be A[σ'], since sub_eq_preserves_exp shows the two are equal types.
Record wf_sub_eq (Θ : gdeps) (Ξ : gstack) (Γ Δ : ctx) (σ σ' : sub) : Prop := wf_sub_eq_intro
{ wf_sub_eq_left : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ
; wf_sub_eq_right : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ' : Δ
; wf_sub_eq_apply : forall x A, Δ ∋ #x : A -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ #x[σ] ≈ #x[σ'] : A[σ]
A module slot is sent to equal module expressions.
; wf_sub_eq_apply_mod : forall x U, Δ ∋ #x ≔ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ sentry_modexp (σ x) ≈ sentry_modexp (σ' x)
}.
Notation "Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ ≈ σ' : Δ" := (wf_sub_eq Θ Ξ Γ Δ σ σ') : type_scope.

The projections are not registered in mctt: each of them has a conclusion (⊢ Γ, Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ) that the corresponding introduction rule also produces, so the pair would let eauto cycle. Lemmas.v states the presuppositions it actually wants as separate lemmas.
wf_wk, wf_sub and wf_sub_eq are all invariant under pointwise equality of the operation: the operation only ever occurs applied to an index or applied to an expression, and both of those respect pointwise equality (exp_wk_Proper, exp_sub_Proper).

#[export]
Instance wf_wk_Proper Θ Ξ Γ Δ : Proper (wk_eq ==> iff) (wf_wk Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  assert (forall φ ψ, wk_eq φ ψ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ φ : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ʷ ψ : Δ) as Himp.
  {
    intros φ ψ Heq [? ? Hlk Hlkd Hlkm].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    - intros x A ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- Heq.
      now apply Hlk.
    - intros x A M ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hlkd.
    - intros x U ?.
      replace (ψ x) with (φ x) by apply Heq.
      rewrite <- Heq.
      now apply Hlkm.
  }
  intros φ ψ Heq; split; apply Himp; [ assumption | now symmetry ].
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_sub_Proper Θ Ξ Γ Δ : Proper (sb_eq ==> iff) (wf_sub Θ Ξ Γ Δ).
Proof.
  assert (forall σ τ, sb_eq σ τ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ σ : Δ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˢ τ : Δ) as Himp.
  {
    intros σ τ Heq [? ? Hap Hapd Hapm].
    econstructor; try eassumption.
    - intros x A ?.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hap.
    - intros x A M ?.
      rewrite <- !Heq.
      now apply Hapd.
    - intros x U HU.
      rewrite <- (Heq x), <- (gunit_sub_sb_eq U σ τ Heq).
      now apply Hapm.
  }
  intros σ τ Heq; split; apply Himp; [ assumption | now symmetry ].
Qed.

Immediate & Independent Presuppositions

The two forms of a literal's typing the proofs below name: at its own sort, the least one, and at sort 0 for a finite one.
Lemma wf_llit_ordinal : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@(fst o).
Proof. intros; apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_llit_of_nat : forall {Θ Ξ Γ n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃@n : Level.
Proof. intros; apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_llit_ordinal wf_llit_of_nat : mctt.
The side condition of wf_llit and of the literal equations: the tier of a literal is at most the sort.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (fst _ <= _) => cbn [fst]; lia : mctt.

A small universe is a type of every large universe.
Lemma wf_univ_large_tm : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M i n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM; eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_univ, HM | apply wf_typ, HΓ | constructor | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_univ_large_tm; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ordinal; assumption ]. Qed.

Prop is a type of every large universe.
Lemma wf_prop_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Propₘ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ apply wf_prop | apply wf_typ | constructor | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_of_nat; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_prop_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Propₘ ≈ Propₘ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ apply wf_exp_eq_prop_cong | apply wf_typ | constructor | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large ]; first [ eassumption | apply wf_llit_of_nat; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' i n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M⟩ ≈ Type⟨M'⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HMt HM; eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong, HM | apply wf_typ, HΓ | constructor
    | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HMt ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ : Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ordinal; assumption | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ]. Qed.

Literal Levels

The literal form of the universe rules, which the closed types and the stage-1 statements are written with: succl 𝕃@n is 𝕃@(S n) and the order on literals is the order on their indices, so the general rules give them back.

The Universe Congruence, Right-Hand Side

Type⟨M⟩ ≈ Type⟨M'⟩ is stated at Type⟨succl M⟩, so presupposition for the right-hand side has to move Type⟨M'⟩ from Type⟨succl M'⟩ there. That is a subtyping, by the level equation maxl M' M ≈ M, which needs reflexivity at M only — and M ≈ M is M ≈ M' composed with its symmetry, so no induction over typing is needed here.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl M' M ≈ M : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros * HM H.
  assert (HMM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M : Level@n)
    by (eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ exact H | apply wf_exp_eq_sym, H ]).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, H | exact HMM ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, HM ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_succl_eq : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl M'⟩ ⊆ Type⟨succl M⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM HM' H; eapply wf_subtyp_suniv;
    [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM' | apply wf_succl, HM |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_succl_maxl; [ exact HM' | exact HM ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_succl_cong, wf_exp_eq_maxl_right; [ exact HM | exact H ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_cong_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' n},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨M'⟩ : Type⟨succl M⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ HM HM' H.
  assert (HT : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl M⟩ : Typeω@0)
    by (eapply wf_univ_large_tm; [ exact HΓ | apply wf_succl, HM ]).
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp;
    [ eapply wf_univ, HM' | exact HT | constructor
    | eapply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl_eq; [ exact HΓ | exact HM | exact HM' | exact H ] ].
Qed.

Below a literal, below its successor.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} o o' n,
    fst o <= n ->
    fst o' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (𝕃ᵒ o') ≈ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (succl (𝕃ᵒ o')) ≈ succl (𝕃ᵒ o') : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros * Ho Ho' HΓ H.
  assert (HM : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o : Level@n) by (apply wf_llit; assumption).
  assert (HN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n) by (apply wf_llit; assumption).
  assert (HSN : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ succl (𝕃ᵒ o') : Level@n) by (apply wf_succl, HN).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption
      | apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl, HN ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans; [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_maxl_assoc; [ exact HM | exact HN | exact HSN ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ exact H | apply wf_exp_eq_succl_cong, wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption ] |].
  apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl, HN.
Qed.

Two literals of one tier, ω·a + b below ω·a + (b + d).
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_tier : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b d n,
    a <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a, d + b)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a, d + b) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b d n Ha HΓ; induction d as [| d IH]; cbn.
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, wf_llit; assumption.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
        [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; assumption | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption ] |].
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right; [ exact Ha | exact Ha | exact HΓ | exact IH ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption.
Qed.

The limit ω·a' is above every literal of a lower tier: absorption, at the sort just below a', moved up to n.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_limit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b a' n,
    a < a' ->
    a' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a', 0)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a', 0) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b a' n Ha Hn HΓ.
  destruct a' as [| m]; [ lia |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_absorb, wf_llit; [ cbn; lia | exact HΓ ]
    | apply wf_level, HΓ | constructor
    | apply wf_subtyp_level; [ exact Hn | exact HΓ ] ].
Qed.

A literal of a lower tier is below every literal of a higher one.
Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_lower : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} a b a' d n,
    a < a' ->
    a' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ(a, b)) (𝕃ᵒ(a', d)) ≈ 𝕃ᵒ(a', d) : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ a b a' d n Ha Hn HΓ; induction d as [| d IH].
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_limit; assumption.
  - eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
        [ apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ cbn; lia | exact HΓ ] | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption ] |].
    eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_succl_right; [ cbn; lia | exact Hn | exact HΓ | exact IH ] |].
    apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_ordinal_le : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} o o' n,
    ordinal_le o o' ->
    fst o' <= n ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ maxl (𝕃ᵒ o) (𝕃ᵒ o') ≈ 𝕃ᵒ o' : Level@n.
Proof.
  intros Θ Ξ Γ [a b] [a' b'] n Hle Hn HΓ; unfold ordinal_le in Hle; cbn in Hle, Hn.
  destruct Hle as [Ha | [<- Hb]].
  - apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_lower; assumption.
  - replace b' with ((b' - b) + b) by lia; apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_tier; assumption.
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_small_large_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o i},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ⊆ Typeω@i.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; [ assumption | apply wf_llit_ordinal; assumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_ordinal_le : forall {Θ Ξ Γ o o'},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    ordinal_le o o' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o⟩ ⊆ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ o'⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ Hle.
  assert (fst o <= fst o') by (destruct o, o'; unfold ordinal_le in Hle; cbn in *; lia).
  eapply (wf_subtyp_suniv _ _ _ (fst o'));
    [ assumption | apply wf_llit; assumption | apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_llit_ordinal_le; [ assumption | reflexivity | assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_subtyp_suniv_succl : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ⊆ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros; eapply (wf_subtyp_suniv _ _ _ a);
    [ assumption | apply wf_succl, wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] | apply wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] |].
  eapply wf_exp_eq_trans;
    [ apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_cong;
      [ apply wf_exp_eq_sym, wf_exp_eq_llit_succl; [ reflexivity | assumption ]
      | apply wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ]
    | apply wf_exp_eq_maxl_idem, wf_llit; [ reflexivity | assumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_univ_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ.
  assert (H1 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩)
    by (eapply (wf_univ _ _ _ a), wf_llit; [ reflexivity | exact HΓ ]).
  assert (H2 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩ : Typeω@0) by (apply wf_univ_large; exact HΓ).
  eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | constructor | apply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl, HΓ ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_lit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ a b},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HΓ.
  assert (H1 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩ : Type⟨succl 𝕃ᵒ(a, b)⟩)
    by (eapply (wf_exp_eq_univ_cong _ _ _ a), wf_exp_eq_llit_cong; [ reflexivity | exact HΓ ]).
  assert (H2 : Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ(a, S b)⟩ : Typeω@0) by (apply wf_univ_large; exact HΓ).
  eapply wf_exp_eq_subtyp; [ exact H1 | exact H2 | constructor | apply wf_subtyp_suniv_succl, HΓ ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_univ_lit wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_lit : mctt.

The universe at an index u, as a term of the large universe just above it: Typeω@j is in Typeω@(S j), and every small universe is in Typeω@0.
Lemma wf_universe_index_term : forall {Θ Ξ Γ} {u : universe_index},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ universe_index_term u : Typeω@(large_level_above u).
Proof. intros ? ? ? []; [ apply wf_univ_large | apply wf_typ ]. Qed.

A universe is closed, so no substitution reaches it.
Lemma exp_sub_universe_index_term : forall u σ, (universe_index_term u)[σ] = universe_index_term u.
Proof. intros [] ?; reflexivity. Qed.

As hints, these fix a large universe the goal leaves open to Typeω@0 (a small one to Type@0), so that a search never ends with an uninstantiated level.
Ltac fix_open_level i := first [ is_evar i; first [ unify i 0 | unify i ordinal_zero ] | idtac ].

wf_subtyp_small_large constrains nothing about the small level, so as a constructor hint it would leave it open whenever the left-hand side is; it applies only to a known small universe.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_subtyp_small_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ ⊆ Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_subtyp_small_large : mctt.
The literal form of the two hints above keeps the depth of a search that only meets small universes at literal levels.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ ⊆ Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_subtyp_small_large_lit : mctt.

#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_univ_large_tm : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_univ_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Propₘ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_prop_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Propₘ ≈ Propₘ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_prop_cong_large : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨_⟩ ≈ Type⟨_⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; eapply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large_tm : mctt.
#[export]
Hint Extern 1 (_ ⍮ _ ⍮ _ ⊢ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ ≈ Type⟨𝕃ᵒ _⟩ : Typeω@?i) => fix_open_level i; apply wf_exp_eq_univ_cong_large : mctt.

The Context of a Judgment

Every judgment presupposes its context well formed. These come first, each by an induction that reads it off whichever premise is stated at Γ.

Lemma presup_ext_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ Ψ Ψ'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ˣ Ψ ≈ Ψ' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; auto.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_ext_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_unit_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_unit_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_modexp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_modexp_eq_ctx : mctt.

A unit equivalence presupposes the reflexive instances of both sides.
Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_unit_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U U'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U' ≈ U'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Equivalent body units have equivalent expansions.
Lemma wf_unit_eq_expand_cong : forall {Θ Ξ Γ Δ Φ Δ' Φ'},
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open Δ Φ ≈ gu_open Δ' Φ' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ gu_open Δ (gm_expand Φ) ≈ gu_open Δ' (gm_expand Φ').
Proof.
  intros * HU; eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ apply wf_unit_eq_sym, wf_unit_eq_expand, (wf_unit_eq_refl_left HU) |].
  eapply wf_unit_eq_trans; [ exact HU | apply wf_unit_eq_expand, (wf_unit_eq_refl_right HU) ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ eassumption | apply wf_me_sym; eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma wf_modexp_eq_refl_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ H H'}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H ≈ H' -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵐ H' ≈ H'.
Proof. intros; eapply wf_me_trans; [ apply wf_me_sym; eassumption | eassumption ]. Qed.

Lemma ctx_decomp_mod : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U},
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U ->
    ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof.
  inversion 1; eauto using presup_unit_eq_ctx.
Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_left : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

Corollary ctx_decomp_mod_unit : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹ₘ U -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵘ U ≈ U.
Proof. intros * ?%ctx_decomp_mod; easy. Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve ctx_decomp_mod_left ctx_decomp_mod_unit : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_exp_eq_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ M M' A}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_exp_eq_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_is_univ_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  inversion 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_is_univ_ctx : mctt.

Lemma presup_subtyp_ctx : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B -> ⊢ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ.
Proof.
  induction 1; mautosolve 2.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_subtyp_ctx : mctt.

The two instances of wf_pi and of its congruence for a type of functions out of a type of the same universe, at a large universe and at a small one.
Lemma wf_pi_large : forall Θ Ξ Γ i A B,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{ak_relevant} A ⊢ B : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π{ak_relevant} A B : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HA HB; eapply wf_pi with (U := Typeω@i) (κd := ak_relevant) (κc := ak_relevant);
    [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | exact HB | constructor ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_pi_lvl : forall Θ Ξ Γ n L A B,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{ak_relevant} A ⊢ B : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π{ak_relevant} A B : Type⟨L⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HL HA HB; eapply wf_pi with (U := Type⟨L⟩) (κd := ak_relevant) (κc := ak_relevant);
    [ eapply wf_is_univ_small, HL | exact HA | exact HB | constructor ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_large : forall Θ Ξ Γ i A A' B B',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Typeω@i -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{ak_relevant} A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Typeω@i ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π{ak_relevant} A B ≈ Π{ak_relevant} A' B' : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  intros * HA HAA HB; eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong with (U := Typeω@i) (κd := ak_relevant) (κc := ak_relevant);
    [ apply wf_is_univ_large; eapply presup_exp_ctx, HA | exact HA | exact HAA | exact HB | constructor ].
Qed.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_lvl : forall Θ Ξ Γ n L A A' B B',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ L : Level@n -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A : Type⟨L⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ≈ A' : Type⟨L⟩ ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ▹{ak_relevant} A ⊢ B ≈ B' : Type⟨L[↑]ʷ⟩ -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ Π{ak_relevant} A B ≈ Π{ak_relevant} A' B' : Type⟨L⟩.
Proof.
  intros * HL HA HAA HB; eapply wf_exp_eq_pi_cong with (U := Type⟨L⟩) (κd := ak_relevant) (κc := ak_relevant);
    [ eapply wf_is_univ_small, HL | exact HA | exact HAA | exact HB | constructor ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_pi_large wf_pi_lvl wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_large wf_exp_eq_pi_cong_lvl : mctt.

A universe is a type.
Lemma wf_is_univ_typ : forall {Θ Ξ Γ U}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵤ U -> exists i, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ U : Typeω@i.
Proof.
  inversion 1; subst; [ exists (S i); apply wf_typ; assumption |].
  exists 0; eapply wf_exp_subtyp; [ eapply wf_univ; eassumption | apply wf_typ; mauto 2 | constructor | eapply wf_subtyp_small_large; mauto 2 ].
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_is_univ_typ : mctt.

The right side of a subtyping is a type of a sort: never the sort LevelSort itself, which is below and above nothing.
Lemma presup_subtyp_right_sorted : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B ->
    exists S, type_sort S /\ Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ B : S.
Proof.
  induction 1; try (eexists; split; eassumption); try (eexists; split; [ constructor | mautosolve 3 ]).
  - exact IHwf_subtyp2.
  - eexists; split; [ apply type_sort_abs_kind; constructor
                  | eapply wf_pi with (U := Typeω@i); [ apply wf_is_univ_large; mauto 2 | eassumption
                                                       | rewrite abs_kind_sort_wk; eassumption | eassumption ] ].
Qed.

Lemma presup_subtyp_right : forall {Θ Ξ Γ A B}, Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ B -> Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ᵗ B.
Proof. intros * H; destruct (presup_subtyp_right_sorted H) as (S & HS & HB); exact (wf_type_of_sort _ HS HB). Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve presup_subtyp_right : mctt.

Subtyping Rules without Extra Arguments


Lemma wf_exp_subtyp' : forall Θ Ξ Γ A A' M,
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M : A'.
Proof.
  intros * HM HA.
  destruct (presup_subtyp_right_sorted HA) as (S & HS & HA').
  econstructor; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_exp_subtyp' : mctt.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_exp_subtyp : mctt.

Lemma wf_exp_eq_subtyp' : forall Θ Ξ Γ A A' M M',
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ A ⊆ A' ->
    Θ ⍮ Ξ ⍮ Γ ⊢ M ≈ M' : A'.
Proof.
  intros * HM HA.
  destruct (presup_subtyp_right_sorted HA) as (S & HS & HA').
  econstructor; eassumption.
Qed.

#[export]
Hint Resolve wf_exp_eq_subtyp' : mctt.
#[export]
Remove Hints wf_exp_eq_subtyp : mctt.

Term Equality is a PER

Reflexivity at a well-typed term is not available here — it needs an induction over typing, so it lives in Core.Syntactic.System.Lemmas together with the PERElem instance that lets saturate_refl use it. The same goes for wf_sub_eq, whose symmetry and transitivity need sub_eq_preserves_exp to move between the types A[σ] and A[σ'].

#[export]
Instance wf_exp_eq_PER Θ Ξ Γ A : PER (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ A).
Proof.
  split.
  - eauto using wf_exp_eq_sym.
  - eauto using wf_exp_eq_trans.
Qed.

#[export]
Instance wf_subtyp_Transitive Θ Ξ Γ : Transitive (wf_subtyp Θ Ξ Γ).
Proof.
  hnf; mauto.
Qed.

Add Parametric Morphism Θ Ξ Γ T : (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T)
    with signature wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T ==> eq ==> iff as wf_exp_eq_morphism_iff1.
Proof.
  split; mauto.
Qed.

Add Parametric Morphism Θ Ξ Γ T : (wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T)
    with signature eq ==> wf_exp_eq Θ Ξ Γ T ==> iff as wf_exp_eq_morphism_iff2.
Proof.
  split; mauto.
Qed.
